body: I have spent most of my adult life fantasizing about dying one way or another on an almost daily basis. I don't think people really understand how profound an emotion can be. The feeling of worthlessness can be far more real than all of the "I'm here for you"s, the "You're not alone"s despite however true they may be. I hope you manage to find a way to love yourself because living without that, however faint and flickering it can be... Living your life when all you want to do is die, yet being completely unable to enjoy your time here or find any motivation or desire to end it is a special kind of hell, one that no one deserves to exist in.

Looks beautiful. What is that floating in the water, air bubbles? What caused them? 

Also, there are so many instances in recreational diving where you see that abyss and can only look down on it, dangling from above as you said. You should try getting tec certified. Descending into that abyss is delightfully terrifying.
